children: Churchill Capital Corp XII reported net income for the quarter, driven by $3.8M of interest earned on trust-account investments, partly offset by $320,934 in general and administrative expenses. It has not commenced operations or generated revenue.
: The company said it had not entered into a definitive agreement with a specific target as of September 30, 2026.
: Marketable securities and cash in the Trust Account totaled $419.4M at September 30, 2026.
: The company withdrew $1M from the Trust Account for working capital during the quarter, exhausting its available working-capital withdrawals through April 29, 2027.
